sentences.text: A vessel engaged in mine clearance shows three all-round green lights, or three balls by day, one near the foremast head and one at each end of the fore yard.
These signals mean it is dangerous for another vessel to approach within one thousand meters.
Vessels under twelve meters, except those engaged in diving operations, aren’t required to show the not-under-command or restricted signals.
And remember, these signals are not distress signals.
A vessel showing them is telling you about her limits, not asking for help.
